reviews.review_msg: for BISC 202: honestly just not fair, 4 versions of midterm test, difficulty is nothing like the practice midterm he sent, he decides to scale some students down and some up just because different versions have different average (10%). I hope he can find a way to fairly grade for everyone or just make the test at a similar difficulty.

Tegan is an amazing professor, he cares for his students and genuinely puts effort into conveying the information in the most digestible way he can. He is very knowledgeable, easily accessible if you need extra guidance, and is happy to help with lab activities. Exams weren't too difficult either. Would certainly take another course with him.

Dr Williams is one of my fav profs I have ever had at SFU. He is kind, funny, and generally makes u want to go to class. Exams r a lil tricky, but he often makes it clear what he will be asking, allows some question choice, and rescales the tests depending on performance. Only drawback is he is somewhat disorganized, but so am I so np

One of the best profs I have taken. BISC 316 is a heavy course content wise, but he does really well explaining the content and helps us connect course concepts throughout the course. He's really patient and it shows that he loves teaching. Exams were a bit hard, but very fair. He's also really funny. Couldn't recommend him enough

Dr. Williams is super funny and really cares about students learning. There's a lot of material so the course is a bit difficult. What he expects you to know is pretty reasonable and he'll tell you. He's open to feedback about his methods. Lecture slides could use more detail occasionally but I'd definitely recommend him!

Dr. Williams really cares about his students learning and his humour made the material enjoyable. There's lots of details so Lec exams were a little hard. Slides sometimes lacked detail so I'd recommend going to class as it helped a lot. Lab exam was reasonable and he was clear on what we should know. He's very nice and open to feedback.

The course content isn't the easiest, but Dr. Williams made it enjoyable. The lab content was more memorization, whereas the lecture content is more abstract and focuses on comparing vertebrate species. He was very approachable and lectures were pretty entertaining from his humour. No real complaints other than the course content itself

He cares a lot about his students and takes time to ensure that everyone is keeping up in the course. Tegan is also very approachable and does a really good job at connecting the course concepts. His slides are quite dense and the course only has one midterm making it pretty heavy grading-wise but other than that, I would definitely recommend
Dr. Williams is an amazing prof. He is so knowledgeable and experienced and he really cares about his students learning. I definitely recommend taking classes with him.
